Nothing's on your calendar today, and with 90% rain the indoor pick is the better bet. Riverbend Community Centre has an indoor open play gym, Saturdays 9 a.m. to noon, $6 per child, for ages 1 to 5, so it fits your 2-year-old. That's per their program page. [link-187000]

If the rain lets up, Cedar Park Conservancy lists a free toddler nature walk Saturdays at 10 a.m. on the park trail. [link-0b6114]
